title: BE PC 200 – January indexation playbook
content: Every 1 January, apply the PC 200 indexation to BOTH minimum scales and actual salaries, for all employees without exception. January 2026 = 2.21%. The annual premium (paid in June) becomes EUR 330.84 in 2026. There is no salary cap on indexation in PC 200.

title: BE Pay Transparency – client readiness note
content: The EU Pay Transparency Directive will apply in Belgium from 7 June 2026. From that date, employers must share pay ranges with applicants and may no longer ask about salary history. Use the Pay Equity module in SD Worx Insights to prepare gender pay gap analysis.

title: NL – annual salary indexation guidance
content: In the Netherlands there is no automatic legal wage indexation; increases follow the applicable CAO or individual agreements. Check the CAO for each client.

title: Legal memo: centenindex, what changes
content: From 1 June 2026 the centenindex applies. For salaries above €4,000, the first 2% of indexation is calculated on €4,000 only (max €80); indexation above 2% applies to the full salary. It overrides individual and collective agreements. PC 200: first impact January 2027.

title: Brasserie Noord BV – pay policy side letter (2024)
content: The employer guarantees that all employees, including management earning above EUR 4,000 gross, receive the full sector indexation every January, calculated on their entire monthly salary. Payroll consultant to apply automatically.
